channel.title: RGUHS MD Pharmacology — Practicals, Narrated
channel.itunes:author: Dr. Harshad Ramineni
channel.description: Narrated model answers for the RGUHS MD Pharmacology practical examination, kept apart from the theory-exam show. Protocol writing first: eight model protocols, from a phase 2 anxiolytic trial to phase 3 registration programmes, each with its design, sample size, visit schedule, analysis, Indian regulatory and ethics requirements, and viva points. About 3 hours 52 minutes.
channel.itunes:summary: Narrated practical-exam answers for MD Pharmacology. Season 1 is protocol writing.
